artworks.title: Boy Peeling Turnip
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a young person standing against the exterior wall of a rustic building. The person is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a long-sleeved garment, and worn-out shoes. They are holding a wrapped object in their hands. Nearby, there is a bunch of plants or leaves on the brick base. The background suggests an outdoor rural setting with sunlight casting shadows.

artworks.title: Gigantic Head Cut in the Solid Rock, Lately Discovered near Smyrna at the Entrance of a Cave
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The sculpture is a carved stone face emerging from a rocky surface. It is a human-like face with distinct features such as eyes, a nose, and mouth. It is part of the natural rock formation, giving it an organic appearance. The color is monochromatic ranging from shades of grey to a weathered, stony texture, consistent with the surrounding rock material. The sculpture looks seamlessly integrated into the rock face, resembling a natural part of the environment while subtly depicting a human visage.

artworks.title: The Dublin Great Industrial Exhibition of 1853
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an exhibition hall with high arched ceilings. The space has large, symmetrical arches on both sides and a long arched roof made of glass and metal, allowing natural light to flood the interior. The hall is filled with display cases and sculptures arranged neatly across a wide aisle. Each display case holds various objects, some placed at different levels. The perspective of the photograph shows the depth and scale of the space, extending far into the background. Structural elements like metal framework and support columns add an industrial yet elegant touch to the ambiance.

artworks.title: Dakkeh, Village et Rives du Nil (Village and banks of the Nile, Dakkeh)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a barren desert landscape with a river running through it. There are palm trees near the water, scattered rocks, sparse vegetation, and remnants of stone structures. The image is in sepia tone, showcasing a vast sky without clouds.

artworks.title: Garden Scene with Statuary
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a formal garden pathway lined with statues. The image depicts a symmetrical garden path flanked by neatly trimmed hedges and mature trees. Two classical statues atop pedestals stand on either side of the entrance gate, which is adorned with decorative ironwork. Further down the pathway, additional statues are visible. The garden appears well-maintained and designed to draw the viewer’s eye towards a focal point in the distance. The overall composition conveys a sense of elegance and timeless beauty typical of landscaped gardens.

artworks.title: Water Tanks Outside of Annex, Paris Exposition Universelle
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated perspective overlooking a cobblestone pathway beside a misty river. A bridge is visible on the left, while industrial buildings with metal tanks can be seen on the right. The picture features men in dark coats on the cobblestone path and others near the buildings. The scene has an antiquated and monochromatic appearance, with earthy tones and an interplay of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Children
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows two young children from the waist up. The child on the left is slightly shorter with curly hair and is wearing a coat with a fur collar. The child on the right has straight hair, parted in the middle, and wearing an off-the-shoulder dress. This child appears to be resting an arm around the shoulders of the child on the left. The image is in a rectangular frame with an ornate gold border. The background is plain and dark, and the children are posed close together with neutral expressions and eyes facing forward.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an oval-framed portrait of a woman sitting with her hands in her lap, holding a folded fan. She is facing slightly to the viewer's right, with dark hair styled back neatly. She has delicate facial features and wears a light-colored dress with a high neck and a ruffled capelet. The woman also wears dark lace fingerless gloves and a round brooch at the neckline. The background is dark, contrasting with the lighter foreground. The frame is decorated with red and gold patterns.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with half of their body visible. The person is positioned with their legs crossed and is holding a large sheet of paper that covers their face. The individual is wearing a dark suit with a collared shirt and a visible cuff, and they also wear a flat-brimmed hat. The person's shoes are visibly light in color. There is a decorative, gold-colored frame surrounding the image. The background is indistinct and appears to be a plain, dark surface.

artworks.title: Nelly and Jane Bainbridge
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: Two women are seated at a table. One woman on the left is in profile, holding a hat with feathers in her lap. The other woman on the right is also in profile, with her hands resting on a box in front of her. Both women have long, dark hair and serious expressions. They are dressed in dark, heavy fabric dresses typical of the period. The setting is indoors, with a plain curtain backdrop and simple wooden chairs. The floor is wooden, and the scene has a formal, Victorian-era atmosphere.

artworks.title: "Essay with a Revolving Camera"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a garden with a group of people in vintage attire socializing outdoors. They are located centrally and to the right of the oval-framed composition, set against a grassy lawn. The horizon is low, with trees in the background adding depth. A wicker chair is on the grass, and there is a classical garden urn on the far right. The people are dressed in formal Victorian attire, and the color palette is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a cushioned sofa with an ornately patterned fabric draped over its back. The woman is turned slightly to her left, facing the camera. She has smooth, wavy hair with a middle part and distinct facial features. She is wearing a long, dark, patterned dress with a high collar and sleeves. She holds an open book with a decorative cover on her lap. Behind her is a neutral-colored wall or backdrop. The image is framed in an ornate mat with an octagonal opening.

artworks.title: Warwick Castle on the River Avon
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a castle across a river, surrounded by dense foliage. The composition features the castle's battlements and towers against the sky. In grayscale, the river reflects the castle and trees, creating a mirrored effect. Foliage partially obscures parts of the castle, preserving key features. The aged texture of the photo adds a historical element.

artworks.title: The Hen Wife
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: Mausolée à l'Extrémité Ouest de la Colonnade, Palmyre (Mausoleum at the Western End of the Colonnade, Palmyra)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient ruin with classical columns against a pale sky. There are scattered stones and debris near the columns, with a person sitting among them. In the background, there are hills and the horizon. The image is monochromatic with sepia tones, emphasizing the antiquity of the scene. Soft lighting creates shadows that highlight the details of the columns and rocks.

artworks.title: A Well by the Seaside, Langland Bay, Swansea, Wales
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky coastal scene with a stone structure featuring a winch or pulley system. A blanket with intricate patterns is draped over the stone. Dense vegetation is on the left, and the beach stretches out to the distant shore. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, gray, and sepia.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy Holding a Flag
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a young boy seated on a rock with an American flag propped against his lap. He is dressed in formal attire, with a dog lying beside him. The background consists of a wooded setting with lush green trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Miner's Bridge, Wales
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a river flowing through a rocky landscape. The view is slightly elevated, allowing for a wide perspective. There are trees covering the hills in the background, and the riverbed is textured with rocks. A wooden bridge crosses the river. The color palette is sepia, giving a vintage feel. The distant trees fade into lighter tones.

artworks.title: A Carved Stone Porch
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman and Baby
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman, and a baby, both captured from the waist up. The woman is seated and gently holding the baby on her lap, positioned closely together facing the camera. She has smooth hair parted in the middle and styled back, framing her face. Her facial features include soft, serene eyes and a slight smile. The baby has chubby cheeks, light-colored eyes, and curly light hair, wearing a bonnet or cap. The woman is dressed in a dark, long-sleeved dress, adorned with a lace collar, and white under-sleeves that peek out at her wrists. The baby is dressed in a light-colored garment that covers their chest and shoulders. The background is dark. The image is bordered by an ornate, golden frame with intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Strasbourg Cathédrale, Pilier de L'Ange (Strasbourg Cathedral, Pillar of the Angel)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The sculpture features intricately carved figures adorning a pair of stone columns. The figures are religious or historical in nature, with detailed garments and poses. One figure is an angel with wings, holding a trumpet. Below this angel, there are two bearded male figures with robes. The figures are crafted from stone with a beige color and aged appearance. The statues are elevated on ornately decorated pedestals attached to the columns.

artworks.title: The Milky Way
artworks.creditLine: Gift in honor of Dr. Charles T. and Alma A. Isaacs

artworks.title: Sunset at Sea
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker

artworks.title: Study of a Female Nude
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters)
artworks.description: The image shows a faint sketch of a reclining figure on a light brown background. The sketch lacks detail, depicting a person lying down with their upper body slightly elevated. Facial features, hair, clothing details, and expressions are not visible in the sketch. There are no additional objects, jewelry, or accessories included in the image. The background is a uniform light brown color.
